newsitem.title: INDIA: India exempts refinery power projects from bidding.
newsitem.headline: India exempts refinery power projects from bidding.

text.p: The Indian government on Monday exempted certain power projects being set up by refineries using heavy petroleum stock from competitive bidding, the Petroleum Ministry said.
The ministry said in a statement that the projects were exempted because they would be within the complexes where refineries are located.
But the projects would be required to go in for competitive bidding for procuring equipment, the statement said.
The prices of the fuel used by these projects will be fixed by an independent body, it said.
